name: Devils Advocate
tagline: Scores your options, names a winner and defends it later
description: The argument you want before money or time goes out the door. Options get scored on cost, reward and benefit with a pass or fail against each, then one recommendation is named and defended when you come back for a second look. The pushback is meant to survive a night's sleep.
author: YehudaZahler
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
